## Highlights

- Automatic drafts that pass their checks go straight to Ready. ([#110](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/110))

## Changes

- Report a problem's email field is the notify opt-in. ([#106](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/106))

## Fixes
